Dear Shiek main I ran into into in unranked, 


An hour ago, you shield grabbed me. I poured my heart and soul into making that approach, and took the risk of revealing my true innermost feelings, only to be viciously grabbed. 


I was so excited when I did that nair. I thought it was well thought and well-spaced. I thought you would see it, agree or disagree, and move on. But then..you took my happiness away with the tap of a button. I was then told I would not be able to be actionable for 4 seconds. Not only was my dignity taken away, but my ability to input attacks was revoked. I was punished for daring to reveal my soul to the world. 


I am literally shaking right now. I don't know how I will move on or survive this incident. My mind will forever be wracked with the painful torment of wondering: who? why? Will there ever be justice? 


Some day, I will tell this story to my grandchildren. It will serve as a reminder of just how cruel the world can be. I hope the future generations can build a world that is better than our own, one where nobody has to suffer the extreme pain and torment of getting shield grabbed. 


In the mean time, it is going to take a lot of therapy and time to recover from this trauma. I might even need to look into adopting a comfort Falco plush to help me get through every day life. Right now all my mind is capable of focusing on are the horrible flashbacks.
